spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

SELECT
    priority,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY issue_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM vw_issue_intelligence
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring});

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name)

  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})

  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring});

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT theme_name)

WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring});

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT skill_name)
FROM vw_issue_intelligence
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring});

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_name)
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring});

SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY issue_count DESC;

SELECT
    skill_name,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM vw_issue_intelligence
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY skill_name
ORDER BY issue_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    issue_key      AS "Issue",
    title          AS "Title",
    customer_name  AS "Customer",
    project_name   AS "Project",
    assignee       AS "Assignee",
    team_name      AS "Team",
    status         AS "Status",
    priority       AS "Priority",
    severity       AS "Severity",
    weight         AS "Weight",
    complexity     AS "Complexity", 
    risk           AS "Risk",
    executive_summary AS "Executive Summary",
    TO_CHAR(created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Created",
    COALESCE(TO_CHAR(closed_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-') AS "Closed"
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
  AND (
    priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
    OR priority IS NULL
)
ORDER BY
    created_date DESC,
    issue_key;
